comment: Every generated document section, its shape, and therefore its only legal writer. See CODE-CONTRACTS.md contract 1. A section-form flag (-ds/-gs/-ss/-rs) rewrites a whole section, which is correct for `narrative` and destructive for anything else: it removes sibling `- Label:` fields or a table. Shapes are derived from what the creation scripts emit; test-document-sections.sh asserts plan_mutable_sections allows only narrative sections.

shapes.narrative: numbered § N.M paragraphs; the section forms may rewrite it wholesale
shapes.fields: - Label: value lines; only -f|--field may write it, one label per call
shapes.hybrid: a paragraph label whose body is field lines; a section rewrite silently drops fields, so treat it as fields
shapes.table: a Markdown table; only its dedicated helper may write it
shapes.empty: no body in the template; becomes narrative once written
